question: What evidence is sufficient to reserve, decline, or request more proof for the @ifabrish-skills / @ifabrish namespace request?
rationale: The code can collect the request and perform an admin reservation, but only staff can verify real-world ownership and decide whether assigning namespace trust is safe.

options.title: Request stronger proof first
options.body: Keep the issue open and ask for public-safe links or a private verification path before any namespace or package reservation.

options.title: Reserve after private verification
options.body: If staff has already verified ownership privately, use the existing admin reservation tooling and leave a public-safe disposition note.

options.title: Decline without verification
options.body: If no credible ownership evidence is provided, close the claim without changing namespace ownership.

recommendation.title: Request stronger proof first
recommendation.body: Keep the issue open and ask for public-safe links or a private verification path before any namespace or package reservation.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision affects namespace and package publishing trust, and CODEOWNERS routes the relevant security-sensitive surfaces to this team.
